question: Should OpenClaw require deterministic migration for the 37 released bundled skills before removal, or intentionally accept a breaking upgrade that requires manual ClawHub recovery?
rationale: Source and release evidence establish that these skills shipped, while the current branch explicitly declines automatic legacy-name installation; choosing capability-preserving migration versus intentional breakage is product and upgrade policy, not a safe reviewer inference.

options.title: Require migration first
options.body: Add and prove a Doctor/Fix or upgrade migration for every released removed skill, including a supported response when no verified ClawHub replacement exists.

options.title: Accept breaking trim
options.body: Approve the capability loss as an intentional breaking upgrade and provide prominent release plus in-product recovery guidance.

options.title: Split independent changes
options.body: Land the Sherpa and generic ClawHub-only official-plugin support separately and defer bundled-skill removal.

recommendation.title: Require migration first
recommendation.body: Add and prove a Doctor/Fix or upgrade migration for every released removed skill, including a supported response when no verified ClawHub replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee with the clearest merged history and maintainer-side context for both the skill ownership split and ClawHub upgrade behavior.
